rows.label: qst650208_msg0001
rows.name: Mo-mo! You're back, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0002
rows.name:
Judging by your faces... looks like
the test run went well, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0003
rows.name:
Success was only natural. With me
there, failure was impossible.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0004
rows.name:
With Hanabuster's support, I think I
fought surprisingly well, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0005
rows.name:
That's good, mo. Any minor problems,
mo?

rows.label: qst650208_msg0006
rows.name:
Neither Hana nor Hana Mk. II has any
problems, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0007
rows.name:
I detect no problems with myself
either.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0008
rows.name: Good, good, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0009
rows.name:
Then, as planned, I'll leave
Hanabuster in your care, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0010
rows.name:
I look forward to working with you
all, friends of the young miss.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0011
rows.name: Likewise!

rows.label: qst650208_msg0012
rows.name: Fumo fumo fumo!

rows.label: qst650208_msg0013
rows.name:
Now then, I'll go into hiding again
for a while, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0014
rows.name: ...Aren't you going to see Dad, mo?

rows.label: qst650208_msg0015
rows.name:
For now, it's better if he can spread
his wings without seeing me, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0016
rows.name:
Hana and Kiku became such splendid
artificial Blades precisely because I
wasn't around, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0017
rows.name:
I've realized Tora and his dad make
better things when standing on their
own, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0018
rows.name: That's too bad, mo...

rows.label: qst650208_msg0019
rows.name: ...Grandpa, will I see you again, mo?

rows.label: qst650208_msg0020
rows.name: Of course, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0021
rows.name: All of Tora's friends...

rows.label: qst650208_msg0022
rows.name:
Please keep looking after Tora, Hana,
Hana Mk. II, and Hanabuster, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0023
rows.name: You've got it!

rows.label: qst650208_msg0024
rows.name: Leave it to us!

rows.label: qst650208_msg0025
rows.name: Please be careful on your way, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0026
rows.name: Thank you, mo. We'll meet again, mo!

rows.label: qst650208_msg0101
rows.name: Say, now that I think about it...

rows.label: qst650208_msg0102
rows.name:
Why is it called Hanabuster? I forgot
to ask.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0103
rows.name: Yeah, I'm curious too.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0104
rows.name: Hanabuster, do you know?

rows.label: qst650208_msg0105
rows.name:
Of course. The young miss chose it for
me.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0106
rows.name: Hana chose it, mo?

rows.label: qst650208_msg0107
rows.name: That's right, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0108
rows.name:
Professor Senzou gave me three names,
and I picked the most sensible one,
mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0109
rows.name: Most sensible...?

rows.label: qst650208_msg0110
rows.name:
They were the ultimate three choices,
mo...

rows.label: qst650208_msg0111
rows.name: Number 1: Hana-chan and Robo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0112
rows.name: Number 2: Staminas A.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0113
rows.name: Number 3: Hanabuster, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0114
rows.name: That's awful...

rows.label: qst650208_msg0115
rows.name:
Grandpa has always had a
catastrophically bad sense for names,
mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0116
rows.name:
Out of those, Hanabuster is definitely
the coolest.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0117
rows.name:
He said the name Hanabuster came from
aiming for performance high enough to
defeat even Hana, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0118
rows.name:
Hana didn't like that part, but I
prioritized how cool it sounded, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0119
rows.name: Hana made a good choice, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0120
rows.name: Fumo fumo fumo, mo.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0121
rows.name:
Now that we know where the name came
from and that's settled, let's really
work well together, Hanabuster.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0122
rows.name: Yes. Likewise.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0123
rows.name:
I'll perform so well I'll make the
young miss faint.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0124
rows.name:
And I'll become the Blade of Hana's
Master.

rows.label: qst650208_msg0125
rows.name: You don't have to try that hard, mooo!
